additional_info.subject: ID0433095-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002186] Charger goes offline repeatedly CRM:02084000160
additional_info.body:
Hello Chlöe, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I checked this issue again and I am certain that the root cause for the disconnections is the poor network coverage:
Router 1
Router 2
As you can see, the signal from both routers is pretty much the same, bad. In sum:
RSRP tells you how strong the signal is from the cell you're connected to (or could connect to).
SINR tells you how clean and usable that signal is among all the other radio chatter, directly impacting your internet speed. In a different way, it's the most direct indicator of the actual data speed and performance.
From my side, I would recommend one of 2 options:
Trial other mobile providers and see if there is any of them that can provide us the network coverage.
Change the network to wired (ethernet cable) or wireless
If users are not able to charge, this is because OCPP is offline and authentication is not possible unless you send a offline list. But if this is a public charging spot, then it will be impossible to forsee every single user.
Let me know your thought and questions. I will wait for your feedback.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
